text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I peek into the dance studio to see
Copano
Rickey alone, racking her brain
over something.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer! I was wondering whether I
could find
a way to work feng shui into
my choreography!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I came up with some moves and
showed them
to the teacher and
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But nobody liked it! They all said my
dancing was
too weird! But it's not weird
at all!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sure! The concept is the Four Guardians
that are
crucial to feng shui!
choice_data_list: ちょっと見せてもらっていいか？
ちょっと見せてもらっていい？
choice_data_list_en: Could you let me see that for a second?
Could you let me take a look?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: First is the Azure Dragon! Gyahhh!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Then it's the Vermilion Bird! Screeeech!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Next, it's the White Tiger! Rawrrr!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And finally, the Black Tortoise! Crawling
along on
its belly! Ungh, ungh!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So! What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: See?!
choice_data_list: 白虎はかわいかったけど
choice_data_list_en: The white tiger was cute, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?! But they're happy moves that
draw on
the power of the Four
Guardians!
choice_data_list: 全体的に怪しい振り付けだなと……
choice_data_list_en: I was just thinking the choreography looks pretty suspicious overall...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You might be right... "Everything in
moderation"
applies to feng shui, too.
choice_data_list: 風水を取り入れるポイントを絞ったら？
みんなが楽しく踊れるのが1番じゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Why not narrow down which feng shui tips to use?
Isn't everyone having fun dancing what matters most?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess I went a little overboard
trying to
make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey comes up with some new

choreography, and I hear it receives a
much
warmer reception.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... What's most important is that
everyone
has a good time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's going to be happy doing
something
they're not into. Okay, I'll
drop my choreography
and go with the
original moves!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
After all, if everyone else is happy, then
I'm
happy. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Copano Rickey goes
straight back
to cheerfully practicing the
original moves.
